title: Second Brain for Mac and Windows
claim: Product Hunt: Second Brain for Mac and Windows — Your AI memory, everywhere you work
why_good: A cross-platform 'AI memory' that follows you across apps — captures context so your assistant actually remembers, a real recall pain.
value: Prosumer subscription for knowledge workers; the wedge is seamless capture + recall across everything you do.
risk: Rewind/Limitless and the OS makers (Recall) are here; privacy concerns and platform-native memory are the threats.
evidence: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Second Brain for Mac and Windows —— 你的 AI 记忆,随你工作到处都在。
zh.why_good: 一个跨平台、跟着你在各 app 间走的 AI 记忆——捕捉上下文让助手真的记得住,真实的回忆痛点。
zh.value: 向知识工作者收专业订阅;切口是在你做的一切之间无缝捕捉 + 回忆。
zh.risk: Rewind/Limitless 和操作系统厂商(Recall)都在;隐私担忧和平台原生记忆是威胁。
